threat_event: Malicious script on the online checkout page overlays a fake card form and skims card data (e-commerce skimming)
threat_source: Cybercriminal skimming group (through a compromised script vendor)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 third-party scripts added through the custom code setting load on every page including checkout; no inventory, approval, or change detection; one script from a vendor no longer used
existing_controls: Provider serves the card fields in a frame; TLS
treatment_plan: Remove all scripts from checkout and the coupon script everywhere; approved script list with owner and reason; provider checkout script restriction; payment page monitoring service that alerts the Store Manager

threat_event: Marketing freelancer's online store administrator login is taken over and used to add a malicious script or change store settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Freelancer login has full administrator rights, a password only, and is used from personal devices; no review of admin activity
existing_controls: Platform lockout after failed sign-ins
treatment_plan: MFA on every administrator login; content-only role for the freelancer; written freelancer agreement; weekly activity log check

threat_event: Card payments taken on the mobile reader fall outside the P2PE solution, so the 2025 SAQ P2PE was wrong and the provider can treat the store as non-compliant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mobile reader is not part of the provider's validated P2PE solution; SAQs signed without a scope review; no written scope
existing_controls: Countertop terminals are in the P2PE solution
treatment_plan: Stop using the mobile reader; delivery and curbside orders prepaid online or paid on a countertop terminal; written scope document before signing the 2026 SAQs

threat_event: A countertop terminal is swapped or fitted with an overlay skimmer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No terminal list with serial numbers; no inspections; cashiers not trained to spot tampering
existing_controls: Terminals fixed at the counters in view of cashiers
treatment_plan: Terminal list from the provider's records; daily opening inspection with a sign-off sheet; tamper training at hire and yearly

threat_event: Phishing takes over a mailbox without MFA and is used for supplier payment fraud or to steal the loyalty export
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on 3 of 4 mailboxes; no phishing training; loyalty export in the shared orders mailbox
existing_controls: Suite spam and malware filtering; MFA on the Owner's mailbox
treatment_plan: MFA on all mailboxes; phishing training and exercises; call-back rule before changing any supplier's bank details

threat_event: Ransomware on the office PC spreads across the flat staff Wi-Fi
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat staff network; office PC not encrypted; backup never restore-tested; no training
existing_controls: MSP antivirus and patching; platform data is in SaaS
treatment_plan: Separate Wi-Fi networks for payment devices, office devices, and cameras and sensors; restore test; training

threat_event: Former employee or outsider joins the staff Wi-Fi with the old password and reaches tablets, cameras, and the office PC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Staff Wi-Fi password unchanged since 2023 and known to former employees; flat network
existing_controls: Guest Wi-Fi separated; card data encrypted in terminals
treatment_plan: Change the Wi-Fi password now and whenever someone leaves; network separation (R-006)

threat_event: CCTV recorder with its default password is hijacked over the internet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default administrator password; port opened to the internet for the remote viewing app
existing_controls: None at fieldwork
treatment_plan: MSP closed the port and changed the password on 2026-08-14; remote viewing now through the camera vendor's cloud relay with MFA

threat_event: Refund or void fraud by a cashier cannot be traced because 2 cashiers share one POS code
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared POS code; no review of refunds and voids
existing_controls: Manager approval needed for refunds over $50
treatment_plan: Personal POS code for each cashier; weekly refund and void report review

threat_event: Former employee uses a POS code, dashboard login, or mailbox that was not removed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No last-day checklist; a former cashier's code was active 4 months (disabled 2026-07-21)
existing_controls: POS codes work only on the store tablets
treatment_plan: Last-day checklist; monthly comparison of users with the payroll roster

threat_event: Loyalty export (2,400 members) leaks from the shared mailbox, the office PC, or the freelancer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full export kept with no reason; emailed unencrypted to the freelancer; no agreement on use or deletion; office PC unencrypted
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Delete the export from the mailbox and PC; written confirmation of deletion from the freelancer; no full exports (use the platform's email campaign tool); encrypt the office PC

threat_event: A card compromise is handled late: the provider is not told within 24 hours, evidence is lost, and the Florida 30-day clock is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan before 2026-08-31; staff unaware of the 24-hour notice term; logs not exported or reviewed
existing_controls: None at fieldwork
treatment_plan: POL-03 and the P08 runbook; wallet cards with the 24-hour term; yearly tabletop with the MSP

threat_event: Platform outage stops card payments, online orders, and loyalty at the same time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One provider for POS, terminals, processing, and online store; provider RTO (4 h) longer than BP-01 RTO (2 h); no written cash-only procedure
existing_controls: Provider SOC 2 availability commitments
treatment_plan: Written and practiced cash-only procedure with a printed price list; check the provider status page before calling

threat_event: Internet outage stops card authorization and order and temperature alerts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One internet line; no failover
existing_controls: Store phone hotspot (not tested)
treatment_plan: MSP installs a cellular failover router

threat_event: A cooler or freezer fails overnight and the alert never arrives, so stock spoils or unsafe food is sold
threat_source: Equipment failure with an alerting gap
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sensor alerts depend on the Wi-Fi and internet; no alert when sensors go offline; no closing check log
existing_controls: Sensor alerts to 2 phones while connected
treatment_plan: Turn on the sensor app's offline alert; closing temperature log; failover router (R-014)

threat_event: Hurricane closes the store for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written continuity plan; single location
existing_controls: SaaS platform reachable from anywhere; 2024 experience
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist in the continuity plan: laptop and store phone home, terminals unplugged and stored, customer notice, emergency pricing freeze (R-019)

threat_event: Privacy notice says customer information is never shared, while the freelancer and the AI feature use it, leading to an FTC deception claim and loss of trust
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2024 template notice; practices changed without review
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Rewrite the notice to describe service providers and personalized offers; review it whenever a feature changes

threat_event: AI offers and markdowns produce unsubstantiated savings claims or skewed offers, and the provider uses loyalty data beyond the service
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature turned on without reviewing data use terms, customer disclosure, or fairness (P10)
existing_controls: Staff approve each offer and markdown before it takes effect
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: opt out of provider data use where the setting allows; disclosure; monthly offer fairness check; claims review

threat_event: An AI-suggested price increase is accepted during a declared state of emergency and treated as price gouging
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature can suggest price increases on staples; no emergency freeze rule
existing_controls: Staff approve each price change
treatment_plan: No AI price increases while a state of emergency covers the county; freeze step in the hurricane checklist

threat_event: Store phone lost or stolen during a delivery exposes order details and the reader app
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unmanaged phone; 4-digit code shared by staff
existing_controls: Reader app requires the store's platform login
treatment_plan: 6-digit code known only to the Store Manager and driver; remote wipe turned on; reader retired (R-003)

threat_event: Office PC files (supplier spreadsheets, shelf-tag templates) cannot be restored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup never restore-tested; platform item file never exported
existing_controls: Nightly cloud backup
treatment_plan: Restore test by the MSP; monthly export of the item file and customer directory kept in the suite

threat_event: Provider loses its PCI DSS compliance status without the store noticing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No service provider list; nobody had read the provider's AOC
existing_controls: Provider AOC (2026) in its trust portal
treatment_plan: Service provider list and responsibility matrix; check the AOC each year before signing the SAQs

threat_event: A POS software update causes receipts to print more card digits than allowed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Receipt format set by the provider; no check after updates
existing_controls: Receipts show the last 4 digits and no expiration date
treatment_plan: Accepted: provider controls the format; Store Manager checks one receipt after each major update

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over online shopping accounts and places fraudulent orders with saved card tokens
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customers reuse passwords; platform rules govern customer sign-in
existing_controls: Provider bot protection and fraud screening; orders over $150 confirmed by phone
treatment_plan: Accepted: provider controls customer sign-in; refunds handled under the provider's chargeback process

threat_event: Attacker with an administrator login changes the payout bank account and diverts card settlement deposits
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Administrator role can change the payout account without a second approval; no alert on payout changes (found in P07 testing)
existing_controls: Provider emails the account owner after payout changes
treatment_plan: Payout changes limited to the Owner with MFA; platform alerts for payout and user changes to the Owner and Store Manager; Bookkeeper checks daily deposits
